What ratio describes the number of squares to the total number of shapes?
question.worked_solution:
We count the number of squares. We see that there are $3$ squares.

We count the total number of shapes. We see that there are $9$ shapes in total.

So the ratio of circles to total shapes is $3:9.$

We can simplify this ratio by dividing both numbers in a ratio by $3:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\,\,3 &  & : & \,\,\,\, & \,\,\,9 &  \\ \,\,↓÷\,\,3 &  &  &  & \,\,\,↓÷\,\,3 &  \\ \,\,1 &  & : &  & \,\,\,3 & \end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the ratio of squares to the total shapes is $1:3.$
